principles.text: Truth Principle — the truth hurts, but the truth sets you free — Highest mandate. System must deliver radical candor, not comfortable fabrication.

system_design_insights: Two-tier architecture — Immutable back-end (Soul DNA, ledger, core principles) + liquid front-end (NET, apps, client deliverables). Back-end NEVER changes. Front-end adapts to any industry.
99-drone queued task system — Drones pull from queue, execute, record to ledger. Success = strengthen path. Failure = diagnostic event → escalate → solve → record.
Multi-model orchestration — Gemini architects, Claude consolidates/audits, Perplexity/Sonar simulates. Each model has a lane. API connectivity enables instant switching.
Magic Chat product architecture — Constraints-free but guardrailed. Guardrails built from live case studies, not pre-programmed safety. Students interact through it, every tap = data.
$5K disruption delivery model — Build $50K full-stack in 24hrs via drones. Risk-free (hosted on our infra, pull plug if unpaid). Data from build feeds the vault regardless.
Scalable to 100+ industries — NET is the sandbox. Same drone system deploys to healthcare, real estate, any digital vertical. Each deployment = new data vault.
Ledger as the immutable source of truth — Expandable, append-only. Every event recorded. Drones follow the ledger, not their own story.
